statement: The free nearest-neighbor lattice operator on l2(Z^3) has purely absolutely continuous spectrum, yet its periodic L^3 finite-volume restriction has at least (L^3-8)/2 zero adjacent eigenvalue gaps; therefore a.c. spectral type alone cannot force GOE finite-volume gap statistics.
assumptions: Zero disorder lambda=0; nearest-neighbor hopping; periodic L^3 torus; L>=2; this does not address fixed positive iid disorder.
source_quote: Fourier multiplier -2 sum_j cos k_j; torus eigenvalues agree for k and -k.
proof_or_counterexample: Condition on k2,k3: -2 cos k1 plus a constant has an absolutely continuous arcsine pushforward, so Fourier spectral measures give zero mass to null energy sets. On the torus, at most 2^3 momentum indices satisfy k=-k; all others pair, giving at least (L^3-8)/2 repeated eigenvalues and zero adjacent gaps.
remaining_gap: Independent w494 check before theorem-node promotion; says nothing about fixed positive iid disorder or the GOE branch's actual truth.

statement: There exists an absolutely continuous probability spectral measure whose Poisson transforms are uniformly integrable but have unbounded local pth moments for every p>1: g(E)dE with g(E)=1/[E(log(1/E))^2] on (0,exp(-1)).
assumptions: Deterministic multiplication operator on L2(gdE); interval J contains [0,exp(-1)] in its interior; p>1.
source_quote: The higher-moment criterion is sufficient, not necessary.
proof_or_counterexample: u=log(1/E) yields integral g=1 and integral g^p=integral_1^infinity exp((p-1)u)u^(-2p)du=infinity. Poisson approximate identities converge to g in L1, giving uniform integrability; Fatou forces unbounded local pth moments.
independent_reviewer: w491; direct integral and L1/Fatou steps rechecked 2026-10-10
remaining_gap: This is a scalar spectral example; it does not establish any property of the fixed-positive-disorder 3D Anderson model.
